recent_news.headline: This Week in Waste: Top Stories Sept 28 – Oct 2
recent_news.summary: Weekly roundup of top waste industry news including RCon 2026 updates, WEF organizational changes, and industry developments. Focus on broader waste management sector news.

recent_news.headline: Fog Cutter Holdings Takes Over Tavia Acquisition Corp. Sponsor Role
recent_news.summary: Fog Cutter Holdings LLC acquired significant share and unit interests in Tavia Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC) on October 1, 2026, assuming sponsor responsibilities and funding obligations. The SPAC subsequently underwent board and management restructuring with new leadership installed.

recent_news.headline: South Bay Wastewater Plant Expansion Advances Amid Tijuana River Cleanup
recent_news.summary: The South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant expansion project advanced during Q3 2026 with completion of the Parallel Gravity Line pipeline and award of the first major construction contract. The project will raise treatment capacity from 35 to 50 million gallons per day, overseen by the U.S. Section of the International Boundary and Water Commission.

recent_news.headline: Driver shortage - Transfer station restricts construction waste
recent_news.summary: Houghton County Materials Management facility in Michigan is down to a single driver due to an ongoing staffing vacancy, forcing the county transfer station to restrict or reject incoming construction and demolition waste.
